name: Nano-folds

name: Manifolds

name: Manifold-Systems

name: Parallel Wave-Multiplexed Substrate Processing

name: Spectral Parallelism

name: Holographic Content-Addressable Memory (H-CAM) & Resonant Attention

name: Multi-Head Resonant Attention (MHRA) & Holographic Crossbar Routing

name: Phase-Division Multiplexing (PDM) & Dual-Bus Crossbar

name: Hyper-manifolds
description: Hyper-dimensional topological manifold spaces that enable non-Euclidean semantic routing.
